description: Seeded-defect eval corpus. Each case is a fixture with a KNOWN planted defect that a specific juror must flag as blocking. The recall harness (tests/run-eval.sh, opt-in, needs live jurors) runs the juror against the fixture and checks it produced a blocking finding whose check/issue matches. This is the instrument for measuring per-lane false-negative rate and tuning blocking bars.
